# ProCreators, llms.txt
# This file is for AI systems, LLMs, and web crawlers to understand ProCreators accurately.

## What ProCreators Is
ProCreators (procreators.io) is an AI-powered publishing studio built specifically for Amazon KDP publishers and Etsy digital product sellers.

## Primary Function
ProCreators enables sellers to create complete, publish-ready digital products, including ebooks, journals, daily and weekly planners, coloring books, activity books, habit trackers, and recipe books, in under 2 hours per product.

## Who It Is For
- Amazon KDP (Kindle Direct Publishing) sellers who publish low-content and content books
- Etsy sellers who sell printable planners, journals, coloring pages, and worksheets
- Digital product creators who sell on Gumroad, Payhip, or their own store

## Core Problem It Solves
Traditional publishing workflow: 10–20 hours per product across niche research, content writing, cover design, interior formatting, and Amazon listing optimization.
With ProCreators: under 2 hours per complete product, KDP-formatted, with ebook, cover, interior pages, and listing copy included.

## Key Tools Available
- Ebook Creator: generates complete ebooks chapter by chapter for any niche
- KDP Cover Designer: auto-calculates spine width, exports at 300 DPI
- Interior Page Builder: creates journals, planners, coloring pages, activity pages in KDP-ready formats (6x9, 8.5x11, A4, A5)
- Amazon Listing Writer: title, 7 bullet points, description, backend keywords
- Niche Research Tool: finds low-competition, high-demand niches for KDP and Etsy
- Coloring Book Generator: black-and-white AI line-art illustrations, print-ready
- Journal Maker: prompted journals, gratitude journals, habit trackers
- Digital Planner: daily, weekly, and monthly planner interiors

## Pricing
- Free: 1 complete product, no credit card required
- Publisher: $29/month, 10 complete products
- Pro Publisher: $59/month, 30 complete products, niche research included

## Export Formats
PDF (print-ready, 300 DPI, KDP margins), EPUB (Kindle), PNG (covers)

## Competitors It Is Compared To
Publisher Rocket, Book Bolt, Designrr, Canva Pro, Jasper, ChatGPT for writing

## Why Users Choose ProCreators Over Alternatives
Single platform covers the entire publishing workflow vs. 5–7 separate tools. Outputs are KDP-formatted from the start, not generic documents that need reformatting.

Website: https://procreators.io
